dévah quartet.bio: Toronto electric string ensemble DÉVAH Quartet combines classical training with rock, progressive music and effects-driven electric performance, including original work and a full-length tribute to Rush's 2112.

edwin.bio: Toronto singer Edwin Ghazal is a Canadian alternative-rock vocalist known for fronting I Mother Earth, his successful solo career and later work with the supergroup Crash Karma.

eleven past one.bio: Bowmanville, Ontario group Eleven Past One was a Canadian pop band best known for the radio single The World Is Ours and melodic, harmony-driven pop-rock.

emmanuel jal.bio: South Sudanese-Canadian rapper, author and activist Emmanuel Jal is based in Toronto and uses hip-hop, storytelling and humanitarian work to address war, resilience and peacebuilding.

face-t.bio: Montréal-born French-Canadian singer Face-T blends reggae, dancehall and electronic music, drawing on childhood years in Jamaica and collaborations across Québec's bass-music scene.

farm fresh.bio: Brandon, Manitoba group Farm Fresh was a pioneering Canadian independent hip-hop trio formed by Mcenroe, Pip Skid and DJ Hunnicutt and closely tied to the Peanuts & Corn label.

frankie payne.bio: Toronto rapper Frankie Payne is a veteran of the city's underground hip-hop scene and a member of the Freedom Writers collective, known for reflective lyricism rooted in his Jane-Finch community.

futurewave.bio: Toronto-born Canadian producer Futurewave, born Martin Budik, is a leading underground boom-bap beatmaker known for rugged sampling and collaborations across independent hip-hop.

glenn morrison.bio: Toronto DJ, producer and composer Glenn Morrison is a Canadian electronic artist known for progressive house, melodic dance production and the international singles Contact and Goodbye.

grandson.bio: American-Canadian singer, songwriter and rapper grandson, born Jordan Benjamin, grew up in Toronto and blends alternative rock, hip-hop and electronic production with politically charged songwriting.

hedley.bio: Abbotsford, British Columbia group Hedley was a Canadian pop-rock band active from 2003 to 2018, with a commercially successful catalogue spanning pop-punk and polished mainstream rock.

hey rosetta!.bio: St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador band Hey Rosetta! was a Canadian indie-rock ensemble led by Tim Baker, known for emotionally expansive songs built around rock instrumentation, strings and piano.

hubert lenoir.bio: Québec City singer-songwriter, producer and actor Hubert Lenoir is a French-Canadian art-pop and experimental-rock artist whose debut solo album Darlène was shortlisted for the Polaris Music Prize.
